---
title: "Labs"
---

There are five labs, one per build module, and each takes 80 minutes of the module session. Each lab page has the full instructions, the tiered task menu (base / standard / stretch), and the verify checklist you grade yourself against. The checklist is pass/fail and spot-checked in the debrief. Starter packs are small zips of templates and checklists. They never contain data or credentials. You download data yourself from public sources, and Module 4's WRDS pull runs on your own account. A public-data fallback track covers anyone whose WRDS access isn't live yet.

| Lab | Builds | Starter |
|-----|--------|---------|
| [Module 1 — Install, project setup, one verified task](day1.qmd) | Working environment, first CLAUDE.md, one externally verified number | [zip](../assets/labs/lab1_starter.zip) |
| [Module 2 — The empirical loop on SEC FSDS](day2.qmd) | Download → clean → figure → replication README, with paper trail | [zip](../assets/labs/lab2_starter.zip) |
| [Module 3 — 10-K text panel + your first skill](day3.qmd) | EDGAR pipeline with quality report, validity protocol, SKILL.md | [zip](../assets/labs/lab3_starter.zip) |
| [Module 4 — WRDS pipeline (live or fallback track)](day4.qmd) | Filtered funda extract → Parquet/DuckDB → metadata table (+ .dta) | [zip](../assets/labs/lab4_starter.zip) |
| [Module 5 — Capstone: harden a pipeline](day5.qmd) | One earlier pipeline made reproducible, verified, and hygienic against the rubric | [zip](../assets/labs/lab5_starter.zip) |

The capstone rubric on the [Module 5 page](day5.qmd) is the course's final standard. Under it, the pipeline reruns from the README, the paper trail matches the commits, no numbers are typed by hand, and a credentials audit comes back clean. Module 6 has no lab. Its deliverable is the position memo described on the [seminar page](../modules/06-ai-knowledge-market.qmd).
